title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-natalie-park-2026-03-04
content:
Morning plan (ETA 9:00 start)
- Quick metrics check: daily dials target 60, meetings booked target 4. Yesterday: 58 dials, 3 booked (ACME follow-up = booked)
- Focus: mid-market expansion list (Region: US, FinTech + Platforms)
- 9:15-11:30 AM: outbound calls + live research on prospects
- 1:30-3:30 PM: email sequences and LinkedIn touchpoints
- 4:00 PM: update CRM / notes + prep for tomorrow

Call list (priority order)
1) Helix Payments - VP Eng (Marta Lopez). Follow-up from demo 2/25. Note: concerned about latency and on-prem option. Action: send quantized latency brief + ask for 30-min technical sync (cc: Jordan).
2) SynergyHealth - CTO (Raj Patel). Left voicemail 3/2. Prospect interested in private deployment + compliance. Action: craft tailored compliance one-pager, check with Security for KMS Qs.
3) Vertex Analytics - Head of Platform (Samir Khan). Interested in dedicated capacity for peak trading hours. Action: propose dedicated + burst pricing, include case study link.
4) OakBridge Capital - Director Eng (Claire). Warm lead from webinar. Ask about current MLP stack and token volume.
5) ClearRoute Logistics - PM (Annie Wu). Demo scheduled 3/10 - confirm requirements and send intake form.

Quick email templates (short)
- Follow-up after demo:
  Subject: Quick follow-up + latency numbers
  Hi [Name],
  Thanks again for the demo - attaching the latency/throughput brief we discussed. Would you be open to a 30-min technical sync next week to walk capacity sizing?
  Cheers,
  Natalie

- Re: interest in Private deployment:
  Subject: Private deployment + security checklist
  Hi [Name],
  I can share our private deployment checklist and KMS/HSM integrations. If you want, I can loop in our Security PM to answer architecture questions. When's a good time?
  -Natalie

Pipeline notes / intelligence
- Helix Payments: main blocker = SOC2 evidence timeline. Offer: expedite evidence + customer references.
- SynergyHealth: regulatory question re: PHI - flagged to Security (ticket PROS-2123). Need compliance one-pager by EOD.
- Vertex Analytics: prefers reserved capacity model; may be sensitive to commit length. Ask finance for a 6-month pilot price.

To-dos (today)
- [ ] Draft compliance one-pager (collab with Security) - target EOD
- [ ] Send Helix latency brief + propose technical sync
- [ ] Email Vertex pricing options to Jordan for review
- [ ] Confirm demo intake form sent to ClearRoute
- [ ] Log all call outcomes in CRM (HubSpot) + update lead stage

Notes to self
- Keep call openings under 20 seconds - lead with value (latency/cost savings).
- Use the new case study slide for mid-market conversations; saves time in demos.
- If technical question hits KMS/HSM, route to Security PM (Avery).
